_note: One of the thirteen rows the audit found printing 'Required 0.0' and 'Deficit (-56%)' side by side. Twelve of Burns' twenty-six soil samples sit in the window where the MLSN K range is narrower in kg/ha than the season's removal — (55.5 - 37) x 1.4 = 25.9 against 64 — so the old flat zero above the ceiling left the season ending below the floor. The Balance figure below (22.8 kg/ha against a floor of 51.8) is the one read off the live Plan page during the audit.

annualRequirement._note: K: max(0, 64 - (62 - 37) x 1.4 x 10 x 0.1) = 29.0. P: max(0, 12 - (32 - 21) x 1.4) = 0, because phosphorus can spare the season's removal and still hold its floor — which is why the P row never carried the contradiction.

balance._note: The Plan page's Nutrient Delivery Summary, K row. With nothing delivered the season still ends at 22.8 kg/ha against a floor of 51.8 — the Deficit the old Required 0.0 contradicted. Delivering the new Required lands exactly on the floor, which is what makes the two models agree by construction.
